item.title: King Slide confident in next 3 years, aiming for US production in September
item.summary: Taiwanese server rail manufacturer King Slide expressed strong confidence in its operations for the second half of the year and the next three years, following the release of its second-quarter 2026 financial results on August 6 and an earnings call on August 7. The company expects second-half operations will outperform the first half, with order visibility remaining very strong.
